rules.visual_effect: Vector arrows point toward each other; force scales as 1/r²
rules.feedback_text: ⚡ Opposites Attract! Force magnitude F = k |q1 q2| / r² increases rapidly as distance shrinks.

challenges.title: Inverse-Square Mastery
challenges.mission_prompt: Halve the distance between the two charges and watch the force arrows quadruple in magnitude!
challenges.misconception_buster: Notice both charges experience equal and opposite forces regardless of their individual sizes (Newton's 3rd Law)!

misconceptions.myth: Rubbing glass or amber with wool creates brand new electrical charges out of nothing.
misconceptions.reality: Friction merely transfers pre-existing outer valence electrons between materials; net charge of the universe is strictly conserved.
misconceptions.explanation: The triboelectric effect involves contact potential differences and electron shearing, not nucleosynthesis of charge.
misconceptions.trap_scenario: When a balloon is rubbed on wool and sticks to a neutral wall, was new charge synthesized in the balloon?

misconceptions.myth: A large +10 Coulomb charge exerts a much stronger repulsive force on a tiny +1 nanoCoulomb charge than the nanoCoulomb charge exerts back.
misconceptions.reality: Both charges experience forces of strictly identical magnitude, governed by Newton's Third Law and the commutative product q1*q2.
misconceptions.explanation: The electrostatic interaction is mutual; force magnitude depends on the product of both charges, not individual dominance.
misconceptions.trap_scenario: If a massive thundercloud (+100 C) repels an airborne dust speck (+1 nC), does the cloud feel a smaller force than the speck?

rules.visual_effect: Fold mountain buckling & oceanic subduction trench formation
rules.feedback_text: 💥 Convergent Boundary! Denser oceanic plate subducts beneath continental crust, melting into magma and thrusting up mountain chains.

rules.visual_effect: Crustal fissure opens with glowing molten magma upwelling
rules.feedback_text: 🌋 Divergent Boundary! As plates pull apart, molten basaltic magma rises from the mantle to create new oceanic crust.

rules.visual_effect: Plates floating on ductile asthenosphere mantle
rules.feedback_text: Plates are in balanced transit over the convection currents of the asthenosphere.

challenges.title: Form the Mountain Arc
challenges.mission_prompt: Drag Plate A and Plate B together until they collide to produce a convergent fold mountain boundary.
challenges.hint: Move the plates toward the center canvas.
challenges.misconception_buster: Notice how subduction occurs because oceanic crust is denser than continental crust!

challenges.title: Open a Mid-Ocean Rift
challenges.mission_prompt: Pull the plates far apart to observe what happens at a divergent zone.
challenges.hint: Drag both plates away from each other toward the outer edges.
challenges.misconception_buster: Busted: Divergence does not create empty vacuum — magma immediately wells up to forge new seabed!

misconceptions.myth: Tectonic plates float like boats on top of a completely liquid ocean of molten magma.
misconceptions.reality: The asthenosphere is over 98% solid crystalline rock that creeps via plastic viscoelastic deformation under high pressure and temperature.
misconceptions.explanation: True molten liquid magma only exists in isolated melt pockets and volcanic magma chambers.
misconceptions.trap_scenario: If you drill 100 km through an oceanic plate, will you fall into a subterranean ocean of liquid lava?

misconceptions.myth: Earthquakes open up bottomless chasms that swallow cities like in disaster movies.
misconceptions.reality: Earthquakes are shear slip events along locked fault planes where friction is overcome; plates slide past or over each other under intense compressive lithostatic pressure.
misconceptions.explanation: Lithostatic overburden pressure prevents deep open chasms from forming or remaining open in the crust.
misconceptions.trap_scenario: Can an earthquake fault open up a 5-kilometer deep bottomless chasm?

rules.feedback_text: Demonstration of F_g = G \cdot \frac{M \cdot m}{r^2} = m \cdot \frac{v^2}{r}

challenges.title: Concept Demonstration
challenges.mission_prompt: Adjust the parameter to observe the direct effect described in Universal Gravitation & Orbital Freefall.
challenges.misconception_buster: Orbital velocity (~7.66 km/s) carries them forward at the exact rate the Earth's surface curves away beneath them.

misconceptions.myth: Astronauts on the International Space Station float because there is zero gravity in space.
misconceptions.reality: Earth's gravity at the ISS altitude (400 km) is ~90% of surface gravity; astronauts float because both they and the station are in continuous orbital freefall.
misconceptions.explanation: Orbital velocity (~7.66 km/s) carries them forward at the exact rate the Earth's surface curves away beneath them.
misconceptions.trap_scenario: If the ISS stopped moving tangentially in orbit, would astronauts continue to float weightlessly?
